goal: Let contractors view but not edit issues in this project
source: hardcoded (Phase 0). Phase 1 replaces this whole object with planner output.

steps.reasoning: Permissions are configured per project, not in the global admin area. That split is the single thing that most often sends people to the wrong screen.
Access controls who can reach the project at all. Permissions controls what they can do once inside, which is the distinction this task turns on.
This screen is read-only. The scheme it displays is shared, so editing is deliberately behind a menu to stop you changing other projects by accident.
Edit permissions changes this scheme in place. Use a different scheme would swap the whole scheme out, which is a bigger change than you asked for.

steps.intent: Remove Edit issues from the Contractors role
steps.reasoning: Browse projects stays on so contractors can still read everything. Dropping Edit issues is the narrowest change that gets you view-only, and it leaves comments and transitions untouched.
